title.narrative: LUX SIDS-CAP Caribbean

description.narrative: Active

Luxembourg program funding for the Pacific and the Caribbean small island developing states over a 5 year period. The funding will strengthen climate resilience and reduce GHG emissions in the regions. The programme will provide support to climate policy and planning, developing and financing adaptation and mitigation, and providing capacity to governments and key stakeholders through GGGI’s on the ground, embedded model. It is expected that this will create the enabling environment needed to support the public and private sectors of SIDS in transitioning to resilient, low-carbon economies.
